claims.content: To allow an Operator to acquire command control of the system during normal mode.

goal.raw_text: To allow an Operator to acquire command control of the system during normal mode.

claims.content: Operator
The RLCS software has a logon screen for the GUI.
The Operator has authorization for command control.
Command control is from a specified workstation.
The Operator requests command control on the GUI logon screen, initiating activation of command control if the Operator has authorization.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator requests command control on the GUI logon screen, initiating activation of command control if the Operator has authorization.

claims.content: The Operator logs onto the system.
Only one operator may be logged onto the system at any given time.
During normal mode, the Operator has command control of the system.
The Operator is authorized to change system mode.

1. If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North; the operator shall be able to dial in from a back up computer to either FCU North or FCU south and open and close the reversible lanes.
2. If FCU North or South fails (FCU Controller failures or FCU-TSU communications failure), alternate control is at the non-failed FCU (North or South).

3. If FCUs North and South both fail (FCU Controller failures or FCUs-TSU and FCU-FCU communications failure), alternate control units include direct control at DCUs 1-5 and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets; the operator shall be able to connect a lap top computer at the DCUs and operate the devices or perform manual operation from the MCU, and connect a lap top on the CMS cabinet and control the signs or perform manual operation of the signs from the cabinet.
4. If any DCU 1-5 fails, alternate control unit is MCU and manual control at the field devices.
5. If any MCU fails, alternate control unit is manual control at the field devices related to the failed MCU; the devices can be manually controlled/operated from their cabinets (e.g.: Gates).

Exception 1: If another operator is already logged onto the system, the Operator cannot be logged on to acquire command control because only one operator may be logged onto the system at any given time; exit the use case without acquiring command control.

Exception 2: If the user does not have Operator command-control authorization for normal mode, command control is not granted; Management has reporting and status checking capabilities only, and Field Maintenance Staff has command control only during maintenance mode. Exit the use case without acquiring command control.
Command control is activated for the Operator.
The Operator has command control of the system during normal mode.
Command control is from only specified workstations.
Only one operator may be logged onto the system at any given time.
The Operator is authorized to change system mode.
If another user is logged in with command control and the Operator takes command control, the other user is notified.
The Daily Diary Log is generated automatically when a user with Operator authority logs on to the system.
